biw_news.title: Audi's Next A4 Delayed Until 2029 As VW's New EV Platform Falls Behind
biw_news.summary: The delay of Volkswagen Group's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) postpones the structural architecture rollout for the next-generation Audi A4 EV. This platform setback directly impacts upcoming modular BIW integration, battery-to-body structural packaging, and floorpan design for future electric models.
